title: SoItsPlushies
description: A small mod I made for plushies of me and friends!
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/58a8ae27bb8d48a4a758e33ad1627653f9c4f11d.png) # About **This is a **WIP MOD** I am still learning I intend to add sounds animations and more as I learn!** **SoItsPlushies adds new plushies of SoItsDragon and his friends more to come. Check them out in the [Gallery](https://modrinth.com/mod/soits-plushies/gallery).** # Getting Started Finding any **colored wool** will unlock recipes for the plushies. Every plushable is crafted **shapelessly** from the **color of wool** for who you'd like to craft. Every recipe is unlocked in your recipe book once you find a piece of **wool**.

Support

If you want to suggest anything, report a bug, or vote on future packs, then join my discord and you can message me in there. I will usually respond very quickly.

**[Check out my other mods here!](https://modrinth.com/user/soitsdragon)**
